--!strict

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local BOMB_NAME: string = "BombMissile"
local TOGGLE_KEY: Enum.KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.X
local SPEED: number = 300
local SPRINT_MULT: number = 2.5
local TURN_SENS: number = 0.003
local PITCH_CLAMP: number = math.rad(85)

local INVERT_AD: boolean = true
local BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET: number = math.rad(90)

local tracked: BasePart? = nil
local bodyVelocity: BodyVelocity? = nil
local active: boolean = false
local yaw: number = 0
local pitch: number = 0
local heartbeatConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local mouseMoveConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local keys: { [Enum.KeyCode]: boolean } = {}

local function findBomb(): BasePart?
	local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild(BOMB_NAME, true)
	if not obj then return nil end
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") then return obj end
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		return obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	end
	return nil
end

local function ensureThrust(part: BasePart): BodyVelocity
	local existing = part:FindFirstChild("NoraPilot") :: BodyVelocity?
	if existing then return existing end
	local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.Name = "NoraPilot"
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bv.P = 10000
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = part
	return bv
end

local function cleanup()
	if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
		bodyVelocity:Destroy()
	end
	bodyVelocity = nil
	tracked = nil
	active = false
	keys = {}
	if heartbeatConn then heartbeatConn:Disconnect() heartbeatConn = nil end
	if mouseMoveConn then mouseMoveConn:Disconnect() mouseMoveConn = nil end
	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	if LocalPlayer.Character then
		local head = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
			Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or head
		end
	end
end

local function start()
	tracked = findBomb()
	if not tracked then
		print("бомбы нет")
		return
	end

	bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
	active = true
	keys = {}

	local cf = tracked.CFrame
	yaw = math.atan2(-cf.LookVector.X, -cf.LookVector.Z)
	pitch = math.asin(cf.LookVector.Y)

	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	print("пилот на " .. tracked.Name)

	heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		if not active then return end
		if not tracked or not tracked.Parent then
			cleanup()
			return
		end
		if not bodyVelocity or not bodyVelocity.Parent then
			bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
		end

		local rot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, 0)
		local forward = -rot.LookVector
		local right = rot.RightVector
		local up = Vector3.yAxis

		local adSign: number = if INVERT_AD then -1 else 1

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.W] then move += forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.S] then move -= forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.D] then move += right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.A] then move -= right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.Space] then move += up end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] then move -= up end

		local spd = SPEED
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] then spd *= SPRINT_MULT end

		if move.Magnitude > 0 then
			move = move.Unit * spd
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = move

		local bombRot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch + BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET, yaw, 0)
		tracked.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position) * bombRot
		Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position - forward * 12 + up * 4, tracked.Position + forward * 10)
	end)

	mouseMoveConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if not active then return end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		if not UserInputService.MouseBehavior then return end
		yaw -= input.Delta.X * TURN_SENS
		pitch -= input.Delta.Y * TURN_SENS
		pitch = math.clamp(pitch, -PITCH_CLAMP, PITCH_CLAMP)
	end)

	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gpe: boolean)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
		if active then
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
			cleanup()
			print("вышел")
		else
			start()
		end
		return
	end
	if active then
		keys[input.KeyCode] = true
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
	keys[input.KeyCode] = false
end)

🎮 Minigame Hub: 22 playable minigames in one draggable, mobile-friendly UI
## Hub features
- **Draggable** by the title bar, clamped to the screen
- **Minimise** to a small pill, **close** to destroy everything and clean up connections
- **Games pause** while the window is minimised
- **Mobile friendly:** scales to the screen, with tap, swipe and on-screen d-pad controls
- **Back button** and a scrollable game menu
- **Session best scores** for every game
- **Pure Luau and UI:** no models, images or sounds, and no server code

## Game list

### Arcade and reflex
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Tap Rush** | Tap as many times as you can in 10 seconds. Shows taps per second and your best. |
| 4 | **Snake** | 14×14 grid that speeds up as you eat. Controls: d-pad, swipe, arrow keys or WASD. |
| 6 | **Reaction Test** | Tap when the screen turns green. Tapping early fails the round. Scored in milliseconds. |
| 7 | **Whack-a-Mole** | 3×3 holes over 20 seconds. Moles appear faster and vanish sooner as time runs down. |
| 10 | **Flappy Block** | Tap or press Space to flap through pipes. Gravity and collisions run on Heartbeat. |

### Memory and puzzle
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | **Memory Match** | 4×4 card flip with 8 pairs. Fewer moves is a better score. |
| 8 | **Simon Says** | Repeat a growing colour sequence. |
| 14 | **Lights Out** | 5×5 puzzle where tapping a light toggles its neighbours. Puzzles are always solvable. |
| 17 | **2048** | Swipe, d-pad or keys. Tiles merge once per move, and you can keep playing past 2048. |
| 18 | **Minesweeper** | 9×9 with 8, 12 or 16 mines. Dig/Flag toggle, first tap always safe, chording, and a timer. |
| 20 | **Sudoku** | Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Easy, Medium and Hard (40, 33 and 27 clues), with hints, reset, timer and highlighting. |

### Quick-think and word
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | **Number Guess** | Guess 1–100 in 8 tries, with a narrowing range hint. |
| 11 | **Math Dash** | 30 seconds of add, subtract and multiply. A wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 12 | **Higher or Lower** | Card streak game. Equal cards are a push. |
| 13 | **Color Clash** | Stroop test where you tap the ink colour, not the word. 25 seconds, and a wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 21 | **Hangman** | 4 categories with 14 words each, a drawn gallows and a keyboard. Has two rare boss words (see below). |

### Versus AI
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | **Tic Tac Toe** | Minimax AI that makes the occasional mistake so it can be beaten. The starting player alternates. |
| 9 | **RPS Battle** | Rock, paper, scissors with a win/loss/draw tally. |
| 15 | **UNO** | Full 108-card deck, wild colour picker, UNO call and catch rules. Choose a **Bot IQ** (see below). |
| 16 | **Connect 4** | Minimax with alpha-beta pruning at 3 difficulties. |
| 19 | **Checkers** | American rules: forced captures, multi-jumps, kings. Minimax AI at 3 depths, with a 50-move draw rule. |
| 22 | **Battleship** | 8×8 board and a fleet of 5, 4, 3, 3 and 2. Shuffle your ships, 3 bot levels. |

## AI details

**UNO Bot IQ**
- **Easy:** random legal plays and random colour picks. It sometimes forgets to call UNO, and you can catch it.
- **Medium:** saves wilds, prefers action cards, keeps its longest colour.
- **Hard:** counts unseen cards, remembers which colours you couldn't answer, and saves +4 for when you're close to winning.

if previous then
	assert(type(previous.unload) == "function", "Existing shooting hook cannot be unloaded")
	local success, reason = pcall(previous.unload, true)
	assert(success and environment.__aimSession ~= previous,
		"Could not unload the existing shooting hook: " .. tostring(reason))
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local ClientShootable = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.CombatController.ClientComponent.ClientShootableComponent)
local Entities = require(ReplicatedStorage.Remote.EntityService)
local HumanoidEntity = require(ReplicatedStorage.Remote.EntityService.Entity.HumanoidEntity)
local Collision = require(ReplicatedStorage.Constant).Collision
local Combat = require(ReplicatedStorage.Config.Config).Combat

local originalShoot = ClientShootable.Shoot
local localShoot = ClientShootable.LocalShoot
assert(type(originalShoot) == "function" and type(localShoot) == "function",
	"The game's shooting functions are unavailable")

local originIndex, originalOrigin
for index, value in upvalues(originalShoot) do
	if type(value) == "function" then
		assert(originIndex == nil, "The weapon has more than one origin function")
		originIndex, originalOrigin = index, value
	end
end
assert(originIndex ~= nil, "The weapon's origin function was not found")

local localOriginMatches = 0
for _, value in upvalues(localShoot) do
	if value == originalOrigin then
		localOriginMatches += 1
	end
end
assert(localOriginMatches == 1, "LocalShoot uses a different combat origin")

local CONE_DOT = math.cos(math.rad(15))
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = false

local state = {
	active = true,
	enabled = true,
	selectedEntity = nil,
	selectedAt = -math.huge,
	preparedShot = nil,
	connections = {},
	reportedSelectionError = false,
}

local function visiblePoint(entity, origin, view)
	local model = entity:GetModel()
	if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return nil
	end

	local candidates = {
		entity:GetBodyPart(),
		entity:GetRootPart(),
		model:FindFirstChild("Head", true),
	}
	for _, part in candidates do
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local offset = part.Position - origin
			local distance = offset.Magnitude
			if distance > 0.01 and distance <= Combat.BulletMaxDistance
				and view:Dot(offset.Unit) >= CONE_DOT then
				local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(origin, offset, rayParams)
				if not obstruction or obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model) then
					return part.Position, distance, part
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function acquireTarget(origin, view)
	local self = Entities.GetLocalEntity()
	if not self or not self:IsAlive() then
		return nil
	end
	local group = self:GetCollision(Collision.Attack)
	if type(group) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end

	rayParams.CollisionGroup = group
	local character = self:GetWorkspaceRoot()
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = character and { character } or {}

	local function isHostile(entity)
		return entity ~= self and HumanoidEntity:is(entity)
			and entity:IsAlive() and not self:IsFriendly(entity)
	end

	if state.selectedEntity and os.clock() - state.selectedAt <= 0.22
		and isHostile(state.selectedEntity) then
		local point, distance, part = visiblePoint(state.selectedEntity, origin, view)
		if point then
			return state.selectedEntity, point, distance, part
		end
	end

	local closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart
	closestDistance = Combat.BulletMaxDistance
	for _, entity in Entities.Entity.GetAll() do
		if isHostile(entity) then
			local point, distance, part = visiblePoint(entity, origin, view)
			if point and distance < closestDistance then
				closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart = entity, point, distance, part
			end
		end
	end
	return closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart
end

local function reportSelectionError(reason)
	if not state.reportedSelectionError then
		state.reportedSelectionError = true
		warn("Target selection failed: " .. tostring(reason))
	end
end

local function redirectedOrigin(...)
	local origin, detectedAt, cameraData = originalOrigin(...)
	if not (state.active and state.enabled and typeof(origin) == "CFrame") then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	if state.preparedShot == false then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	local entity, point
	if state.preparedShot then
		entity, point = state.preparedShot.entity, state.preparedShot.point
	else
		local success, selected, selectedPoint = pcall(acquireTarget, origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
		if not success then
			reportSelectionError(selected)
			return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
		end
		entity, point = selected, selectedPoint
	end

	if not point then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end
	local offset = point - origin.Position
	if offset.Magnitude <= 0.001 or origin.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	state.selectedEntity = entity
	state.selectedAt = os.clock()
	return CFrame.lookAt(origin.Position, point), detectedAt, cameraData
end

local function runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, prepared)
	state.preparedShot = prepared
	local success, result = pcall(originalShoot, component, start, direction, context)
	state.preparedShot = nil
	if not success then
		error(result, 0)
	end
	return result
end

local function shootWithTarget(component, start, direction, context)
	if not (state.active and state.enabled) then
		return originalShoot(component, start, direction, context)
	end

	local success, origin = pcall(originalOrigin)
	if not success or typeof(origin) ~= "CFrame" then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local selected, entity, point, _, part = pcall(acquireTarget, origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
	if not selected then
		reportSelectionError(entity)
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end
	if not entity or not point then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local pivot = entity:GetPivot(true)
	local offset = point - origin.Position
	if not pivot or offset.Magnitude <= 0.001 or origin.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local shotContext = context or {}
	shotContext.Target = entity.Instance
	shotContext.TargetPos = pivot:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	shotContext.TargetHeadshot = part ~= nil and part.Name == "Head"
	return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, shotContext, { entity = entity, point = point })
end

function state.unload(silent)
	if not state.active then
		return
	end
	state.active = false
	state.enabled = false
	for index = #state.connections, 1, -1 do
		state.connections[index]:Disconnect()
		state.connections[index] = nil
	end

	if ClientShootable.Shoot == shootWithTarget then
		ClientShootable.Shoot = originalShoot
	else
		warn("Shoot changed externally; original function was not restored")
	end
	if getupvalue(originalShoot, originIndex) == redirectedOrigin then
		setupvalue(originalShoot, originIndex, originalOrigin)
	else
		warn("Combat origin changed externally; original function was not restored")
	end
	if environment.__aimSession == state then
		environment.__aimSession = nil
	end
	if not silent then
		notify("Silent Aim", "Unloaded", 5)
	end
end

setupvalue(originalShoot, originIndex, redirectedOrigin)
assert(getupvalue(originalShoot, originIndex) == redirectedOrigin,
	"Could not install the combat origin redirect")
ClientShootable.Shoot = shootWithTarget
environment.__aimSession = state

state.connections[1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		return
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		state.enabled = not state.enabled
		notify("Silent Aim", state.enabled and "Enabled" or "Disabled", 4)
	elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.End then
		state.unload()
	end
end)

notify("The Controls", "Right Shift - toggle silent aim\nEnd - unload the script", 20)
